source: 807 Overlooked
target: 807 Neglectus

source: 807 Overlooked
target: 807 Neglectus

source: Morora’s night was devoid of streetlights, relying solely on the crimson moon high above to provide light, casting deep darkness and dense shadows everywhere.
target: Nox Mororae caruit luminariis viariis, solum confisens in lunam rubram excelsam quae lucem praebebat, diffusens profundas tenebras atque densas umbras ubique.

source: Gusain, dressed like a gentleman, carried a lantern as he led Lumian to a neighborhood near the edge of the city.
target: Gusain, more viro urbanitatis indutus, lucernam portabat dum Luminum ad vicinitatem prope fines urbis ducebat.

source: The area had been completely abandoned due to a small volcano that had erupted, swallowing several houses and leaving a charred wasteland in its wake.
target: Regio tota deserta erat ob parvum vulcanum eruptum, quod complura domicilia devoravit et vastam terram incensam reliquit.

source: “The place you mentioned isn’t at the base of the volcano, is it?” Lumian glanced around, adjusted his cuff, and smiled.
target: «Locus quem memorasti non est ad radicem vulcani, an non?» Luminum circumspicuit, manicam rectificans, et subridens.

source: Gusain nodded slightly.
target: Gusain leviter annuit.

source: “Yes, the volcanic eruption affected the underground part of the cemetery, allowing its power to seep out. The lava receded quickly, leaving behind an empty void.
target: «Ita, eruptio vulcanica partem subterraneam cimiterii attigit, sinens potentiam eius se effundere. Lava celeriter recedebat, relinquens vacuum spatium.»

source: “If you can find the right path through the void filled with the fog of war and reach the designated spot, it will prove you have the qualifications to join us in penetrating the underground part of the cemetery.”
target: «Si viam rectam per vacuum, nebula belli referta, inuenies atque locum designatum attinges, id demonstrabit te habere aptitudinem ut nobiscum in partem subterraneam cimiterii penetres.»

source: Fog of war…
target: Nebula belli…

source: Gusain had been using this term to describe the underground fog, which seemed to have leaked from the mausoleum containing 0-01, which represents the Red Priest…
target: Gusain hoc verbum adhibebat ad describendam nebula subterranea, quae videtur effluisse ex mausoleo quod 0-01 continet, qui Sacerdotem Rubrum repraesentat…

source: Lumian didn’t conjure a bright white fireball for illumination.
target: Lumian non evocavit globum ignis albidum nitidum ad illuminationem.

source: Instead, he followed Gusain, who carried the lantern, into a building on the edge of the volcanic area.
target: Immo, secutus est Gusain, qui lucernam portabat, in aedificium iuxta limitem areae vulcanicae.

source: Inside the house, filled with solidified volcanic rock, they descended a precarious staircase into a partially collapsed basement.
target: Intra domum, plena lapide vulcanico solidato, descendebant per scalas incertas in cellam partim ruinosam.

source: The basement walls had a gaping crack leading to a void filled with dense fog.
target: Parietes cellae habebant fissuram ingentem quae ad vacuum repletum nebula densa ducebat.

source: “You need to reach this point near the cemetery’s underground section and light the oil lamp between four stone statues. Remember, there are four statues facing each other in pairs.”
target: «Ad hunc locum iuxta partem subterraneam cimiterii attingere debes et lampadem olei inter quattuor statuas lapideas accendere. Memento, quattuor statuae sunt, dispositae in duas pares inter se oppositas.»

source: Gusain hung the lantern on a protruding stone brick in the wall crack and took out a simple map, pointing to the destination.
target: Gusain lucernam in lapide proeminente in fissura parietis suspendit et mappam simplicem extraxit, ad metam indicans.

source: Lumian studied the map for a minute, then turned his gaze to the dense fog outside the crack.
target: Lumian mappam per unum minutum studuit, deinde oculos convertere in nebula densam extra fissuram.

source: “What’s special about this fog?”
target: «Quid in hac nebula speciale est?»

source: Gusain pressed his top hat and smiled.
target: Gusain pileum altum stringens et subridens.

source: “It significantly reduces your visibility, affects your hearing and smell, suppresses your Astral Projection’s interaction with the spirit world, and dulls your spiritual warning and intuition.”
target: «Notabiliter minuit tuam visibilitatem, auditum, et olfactum, cohibet interactionem proiectionis astralis cum mundo spirituum, atque atenuat praemonitionem spiritualem et intuitionem.»

source: “And?” Lumian asked, seemingly relaxed.
target: «Et?» inquit Lumian, videbatur relaxatus.

source: Gusain thought for a few seconds.
target: Gusain per pauca secunda meditatus est.

source: “The fog of war envelops the corresponding spirit world area. Some Beyonders, even if they can enter the spirit world, can’t locate themselves or escape the fog. If they try to teleport out, they might get lost somewhere in Morora and never return to reality.”
target: «Nebula belli totam regionem mundi spirituum circumcludit. Aliqui Beyonders, etiam si in mundum spirituum ingredi possunt, se determinare nec e nebula effugere valent. Si conantur teleportare, forte in Morora peribunt et numquam ad realitatem redeunt.»

source: Seeing means being able to teleport there? With my Hunter’s vision, I can only see five or six meters…
target: Viderene, ergo, significat teleportare posse illuc? Ex mea Venatoris visione, tantum quinque vel sex metra videre possum…

source: Lumian roughly understood the fog’s effects and laughed.
target: Lumian efficaciter effectus nebulae intellexit et risit.

source: “If I could create a hurricane, could I blow it away?”
target: «Si procellam similis turbine creare possem, an eam depellere valeam?»

source: “We’ve tried. You can, but once the wind stops, the fog comes back, and the dispersal is limited to reality, not affecting the part seeping into the spirit world,” Gusain explained the previous experiment’s results.
target: «Experti sumus. Possis, sed cum ventus cessaverit, nebula refertur, et diffusio ad realitatem tantum limitatur, non afficiens partem in mundum spirituum se effundentem,» explicavit Gusain eventus experimenti praeleti.

source: Lumian asked a few more details, then conjured a bright white flame to hover above his head.
target: Lumian plura interrogavit, deinde flammam ignis albidum nitidum super caput suum conjuravit.

source: He stepped forward, through the crack, and into the dense fog.
target: Procedit per fissuram in nebula densam.

source: Unlike normal fog, this one felt like it had been scorched by fire.
target: Haec nebula, dissimilis nebulæ ordinariae, quasi igne conflagrata videbatur.

source: As Lumian inhaled, his airways stung with a fiery pain, and his mind filled with the smell of burning, blood, and rust.
target: Cum Lumian inhauriret, viae respiratoriae eius igneo dolore flagitabantur, et mens ejus odoribus combustionis, sanguinis, atque ferruginei implebatur.

source: The dense fog churned, and the ground trembled slightly.
target: Nebula densa turbarebatur, et terra leviter tremuit.

source: Lumian saw tall figures emerging from the fog five or six meters away.
target: Lumian conspexit figuras altas ex nebula emergentes, quinque vel sex metris distantibus.

source: These figures were made of black iron, covered in dark red rust, like neglected metal puppets.
target: Hae figurae ex ferro nigro factae erant, opertae rubra obscura ferrugine, instar marionettarum metallicarum neglectarum.

source: Some lacked arms, others had disjointed bodies, and some had gaping holes in their chests.
target: Aliqui bracchia carebant, alii corpora disiuncta exhibebant, et quidam in pectoribus fissuras ingentes ostenderunt.

source: They staggered towards Lumian, wielding giant swords that gleamed coldly.
target: Ipsi ad Luminum titubaverunt, gladii ingentes ferentes qui frigide micabantur.

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subridens risit.

source: “Who dug you out of the trash heap? Recycling, huh?”
target: «Quis te ex vasto conglutinato immunditatis effodit? Recyclatio, nonne?»

source: Before he finished speaking, he disappeared from his spot, reappearing behind one of the iron puppets.
target: Antequam dixerit, evanuit e loco suo, et post unam ex marionettis ferreis rediviens apparuit.

source: His eyes turned iron‑black, and his right fist ignited with bright white flames, crashing down on the puppet’s waist.
target: Oculi ejus in ferro nigri colore facti sunt, et dexter pugnus, accensus igni albi nitidi, in latus marionettae percussus est.

source: Suddenly, a bright white flame spear shot from the crack in the wall, hurtling towards Lumian.
target: Subito, hasta ignis albi nitidi ex fissura parietis emissa, ad Luminum festinanter properavit.

source: Lumian couldn’t dodge or use Spirit World Traversal in time.
target: Lumian tempore nec defugere nec transitus in mundum spirituum adhibere potuit.

source: He could only fall to the ground, following the momentum of his right punch.
target: Solum ad terram cadere potuit, impulsu dextri ictus sequerens.

source: At the same time, he prepared to swap places with his shadow.
target: Eodem tempore praeparatus erat ut locum cum umbra sua permuteret.

source: Bang!
target: Bang!

source: His flaming right fist struck the puppet’s waist, creating a spiderweb of cracks.
target: Dexter pugnus eius flammis ardens latus marionettae percussit, telam fissurarum instar araneae creans.

source: Then, his fist brushed against the metal surface, pulling his body to the ground, narrowly avoiding the white flame spear, though a lock of his hair caught fire.
target: Deinde, pugnus eius superficiem metallicam percussit, corpus suum in terram trahens, vix vitans hastae ignis albi imminenti, sed fasciculus capillorum eius ignem cepit.

source: With a clatter, the white flame spear pierced the puppet and landed two meters away, revealing Gusain in his top hat.
target: Cum strepitu, hasta ignis albi per marionettam penetravit et duos metra ab ipsa cecidit, ostendens Gusain sub pileo suo alto.

source: The invigilator was the attacker!
target: Ille inspector erat aggressor!

source: The second most dangerous person in Morora!
target: Secundus inter homines periculosissimos in Morora erat!

source: Creak! Creak! The puppet took a step forward out of inertia, then collapsed into a heap of scrap metal.
target: Stridulus! Stridulus! Marionetta ex inertia unum gressum cepit, deinde in congeriem metallorum reiectorum corruit.

source: Lumian, lying on the ground, didn’t roll away. Since he hadn’t gone far from the basement, he teleported to the crack covered in dense fog, moving as far as his vision allowed to escape the fog of war.
target: Lumian, iacentem in terra, non se volvit. Cum a cella subterranea non longe discessisset, ad fissuram, tegendam nebula densa, se teleportavit, quantum visio eius sineret ad nebula belli effugiendum.

source: Once outside, he could either counterattack Gusain or find a chance to escape, both better options than fighting in a preset scenario.
target: Postquam extra erat, vel contra Gusain repugnare poterat aut occasionem ad effugiendum quaerere, utrumque melius quam in praeconstituta scaena pugnare videbatur.

source: Whenever possible, avoid fighting in someone else’s setup!
target: Quoties possibile, vitanda est pugna in praeordinata configuratione alicujus!

source: As Lumian’s figure appeared in the dense fog near the basement crack, he saw a bright white flaming metal spear rushing towards his heart as if waiting for him to come.
target: Cum figura Luminum in nebula densa prope fissuram cellae apparuit, vidit hastam metallicam ignis albi nitidi, ad cor eius festinanter properantem, quasi eum exspectaret.

source: Besides Gusain, there was another ambusher!
target: Praeter Gusain, alius insidiator adfuit!

source: Gusain’s attack seemed to lure Lumian to teleport towards the exit, stepping into a trap!
target: Impetus Gusain videbatur Luminum ad exitum teleportare allicere, in insidias ingrediens!

source: At this moment, Lumian, in Morora, far from Franca and Jenna, couldn’t use their Mirror Substitution.
target: Hoc tempore, Lumian in Morora, longe ab Franca et Jenna, eorum Speculi Substitutionem uti non potuit.

source: He could only swap places with his shadow in a flash of light.
target: Solum locum cum umbra sua in fulgore lucis commutare potuit.

source: Pfft!
target: Pfft!

source: The bright white flaming spear pierced Lumian’s chest, setting him ablaze.
target: Hasta ignis albi nitidi lucens pectus Luminum percussit, eum incendens.

source: But Lumian’s figure turned thin and black, dissolving like a shadow in the firelight.
target: At figura Luminum facta est tenuis et nigra, dissolvens quasi umbra in lumine ignis.

source: The spear‑wielding man stepped through the crack into the fog of war.
target: Vir hastam ferens per fissuram in nebula belli ingreditus est.

source: His hair was tinged with blood, his features aggressive, and he wore a black and red jacket. He was Albus Medici.
target: Capilli ejus sanguine tincti erant, vultus ejus aggressivi, et iaccam nigram et rubram gerebat. Erat Albus Medici.

source: Albus Medici, whom Gusain was supposed to be looking for, was here!
target: Albus Medici, quem Gusain quaerere debebat, hic aderat!

source: Lumian’s figure reappeared in another direction, but due to the fog of war, he was still within six meters of Albus, Gusain, and the remaining iron puppets.
target: Figura Luminum alio in loco redivit, sed propter nebula belli, adhuc intra sex metra ab Albo, Gusain, et reliquis marionettis ferreis manebat.

source: He saw Gusain’s forehead glow red, something about to emerge. Albus’s hair was covered in red flames, lengthening as it spread.
target: Vidit frontem Gusain rubescere, aliquid imminere velle; capilli Albi rubris flammarum operiebantur, dilatantes dum se diffundeabant.

source: “Traitor,” Gusain whispered, sentencing him.
target: «Proditor,» submurmuravit Gusain, eum damnans.

source: He then created several bright white fireballs, hurling them at Lumian to cover every corner.
target: Deinde creavit plura globos ignis albi nitidi, quos contra Luminum iactabat, ut omnem angulum tegerent.

source: He seemed unafraid of affecting himself or Albus, though they were only five or six meters apart, and the fireballs could flatten the Carnivore bar.
target: Videbatur non timere se nec Album laedere, quamquam inter se tantum quinque vel sex metra erant, et globi ignis potentes tabernam Carnivorum comprimere poterant.

source: Hearing Gusain’s words and seeing Albus’s stance, Lumian understood why he was attacked: He had overlooked the Iron and Blood Cross Order!
target: Verba Gusain audiens et statum Albi videns, Lumian intellexit cur aggressus esset: Ordinem Crucis Ferreae et Sanguinis negliguerat!

source: This secret organization, primarily following the Hunter path, was also searching for 0-01. Over the years, someone had likely infiltrated Morora.
target: Haec societas secreta, praesertim viam Venatoris sequens, etiam 0-01 quaerebat. Per annos, aliquis verisimiliter in Mororam infiltraverat.

source: One of them was Gusain!
target: Unus ex iis erat Gusain!

source: With the core members of the Iron and Blood Cross Order’s strange connection to Fourth Epoch Trier, they could maintain some self‑awareness in Morora. Using 0-01 to sense the approaching enforcement team made sense, fitting Gusain’s behavior!
target: Cum membris principalibus Ordinis Crucis Ferreae et Sanguinis insueta nexu ad Quartam Epocham Trier, aliquam sui conscientiam in Morora tenere poterant. Usus 0-01 ut turmam coercitivam appropinquantem sentiret, rationem habuit, conveniens mores Gusain.

source: Now, it seemed Albus Medici was still cooperating with the Iron and Blood Cross Order, using the secret organization.
target: Nunc, videtur Albus Medici adhuc cum Ordine Crucis Ferreae et Sanguinis cooperari, societatem secretam adhibens.

source: Lumian’s attempt to use Gusain’s power to find Albus had been turned into a trap.
target: Conatus Luminum ut potentiam Gusain ad Album inveniendum adhiberet, in insidias versa erat.

source: Seeing the incoming bright white fireballs and Albus blocking the exit, Lumian didn’t hesitate.
target: Cum vidisset globos ignis albi nitidi imminentes et Album exitum obstruere, Lumian non dubitavit.

source: His sleeve flashed, and he disappeared again.
target: Manica ejus micavit, et iterum evanuit.

source: This time, he left behind a makeup mirror.
target: Hoc tempore, speculum ornamentale relinquit.

source: The mirror fell through the dense fog, cracking as it hit the ground.
target: Speculum per nebula densam cecidit, fractum cum terram contingens.

source: Rumble!
target: Rumble!

source: Gusain’s fireballs exploded, only affecting a six‑meter range, unable to disperse the dense fog of war, confined to a small area.
target: Globuli ignis Gusain erupti sunt, solum ambitum sex metrorum afficiens, nec nebulae belli densi diffundi potuerunt, in parvo spatio confinati.

source: The mirror shattered into countless pieces, some turning to dust, others melting and reforming.
target: Speculum in innumerabilia fragmenta confractum est, quaedam in pulverem versa, alia liquefacta et reformata.

source: Albus, feeling the impact and heat, muttered in confusion, “Using the mirror world?”
target: Albus, ictum et calorem sentiens, confusus submurmuravit: «Uti mundum speculi?»

source: Behind the dark void of the mirror, Lumian used the Mirror Cufflink again, quickly looking forward and finding the fog of war hadn’t invaded the dark, web‑like tunnels.
target: Post vacuum obscurum speculi, Lumian iterum Cingulum Speculi adhibuit, celeriter prospiciens et inveniens tunelas obscuras, reticulis similes, ab nebula belli non invasas esse.

source: Indeed, in Morora, the mirror world is special… Lumian dared to trust Gusain and enter the fog of war for the test because he had the Mirror Cufflink.
target: Revera, in Morora, mundus speculi peculiaris est… Lumian ausus est Gusain credere et in nebula belli intrare pro probatione, quia Cingulum Speculi habebat.

source: Of course, with items like the Sword of Courage, he wasn’t without fighting strength, but he didn’t want to risk it in an enemy’s prepared battlefield without knowing Albus’s full capabilities.
target: Certe, cum rebus ut Gladio Fortitudinis, non caret virtute pugnae, sed noluit id in campo hostis praeparato periclitari, nisi totam facultatem Albi cognovisset.

source: Lumian chose a mirror mark in Morora and used Spirit World Traversal to leave.
target: Lumian signum speculi in Morora elegit et Transitus Mundi Spirituum ad discessum adhibuit.

source: As he vanished, the dark void behind the mirror silently collapsed with its shattering.
target: Dum evanuit, vacuum obscurum post speculum silentio corruit, se frangens.

source: Lumian’s destination was Julie’s room mirror.
target: Meta Luminum fuit speculum cubiculi Juliae.

source: Upon arrival, he looked through the glass, finding Julie, the Demoness, nowhere to be seen, not even asleep in bed.
target: Adventu facto, per vitrum intuebatus invenit Juliam, daemonissam, nusquam apparere, ne etiam in lecto dormientem.

source: Lumian’s lips curled into a smile.
target: Labia Luminum in risum contorta sunt.
